description:
We have made a game for kides up to 7-11 years old. This game is not only fun but gives an overview an teaches players about all the planets. There are also trivia questions.

Here is the link to our game: https://spacex-mango-mission.mango-squad.workers.dev
summary: SPACEX MANGO MISSION🥭 is a hands-on game that we have made. Its not only fun but teaches kids from age 7-11 years old all about the 7 planets. It also has trivia questions. Our game works like this: go explore each planet, answer trivia questions, and collect mangoes and bring them back to your ship before you run out of oxygen. BUT, there is a twist; everything is a trade-off! Meaning, if you want more food, then you have to have less water; your ship only has so much space. You get to choose you own rocket, and spacesuit, and start exploring! In this mission, you have to watch out for your oxygen, health, hunger, and fuel (you can only refuel 2 times). You also have to watch out of how many mangos you put in your ship. If you put too much, then an alarm will sound! This game can also be played solo, and teams of 2-4 players! Every choice counts when you're millions of miles from Earth. It’s a thrilling race against the clock that teaches kids real space facts and smart decision-making—all without them even realizing they're learning. Grab your crew and get ready for blastoff!
details:
Kids love games, and they play them a lot. But the problem is that they don't learn anything while playing. The hands-on game we made is super fun and teaches kids about space and all 7 planets! It includes trivia questions, and players can play solo and in teams of 2-4. They can choose their ship and space suit. Some ships carry more cargo but use a lot of fuel. Some space suits let you jump higher, while others pull you down. Each planet has a different amount of gravity and a different jump height. The player's job is to explore each planet, learn about it, grab all the mangos and put them in their ship, run away from the evil mangos, and save as many mangos as you can. But watch out! If you put too many in your ship, then it will become too heavy! There is a twist! Everything is a trade-off. Meaning, if you want more food, then you need less water. We hope you enjoy playing our game!
